exposure: Uterine artery (UA) Doppler parameters (mean pulsatility index, mean resistance index, presence of bilateral protodiastolic notch)
UA mean RI at first and second trimesters
outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Elevated UA mean resistance index (RI) and mean pulsatility index in the first trimester were independent predictors of hypertensive disorders during pregnancy.
gest_age: First trimester (11-14 weeks) and second trimester (20-24 weeks)
